text: Plans change. The job belongs to someone else, or it can't start until next week, or you're about to be away. Move hands a task on without losing its notes or history.
The one thing to remember: before time off, open Future and click Re-assign all on this tab.
This call is really a client liaison job.
Click Move.
Assign it to Casey Morgan.
Keep me watching is ticked, so it stays on your Watching tab until Casey's done. Untick it if you don't need to follow it.
You can change when it starts, or when it's due, here too.
And who's watching it.
Leave a note, so Casey knows why it's coming.
Save.
It's on Casey's list now, and the note is in its history.
Now say you're away next week. Click Future.
These start while you're gone.
To hand off only some of them, tick their boxes and use Re-assign selected.
To hand off all of them, click Re-assign all on this tab.
Pick who's covering. If you're not sure, pick your manager.
You can also add watchers to every task, for example your manager. Each task keeps its own watchers either way.
Save.
Future is empty, so nothing waits on you while you're away.

The most common mistakes: leaving for time off with tasks still in Future, and moving a task with no note, so the next person has to guess. Remember: before time off, open Future and click Re-assign all on this tab.
